zh: 我每天都看新闻，跟上最新的事情。
old_en: I keep up with the latest news by watching it every day.
new_en: I watch the news every day to keep up with what is happening.

zh: 我经常和朋友聊天，保持联系。
old_en: I often chat with friends to keep up our connection.
new_en: I often chat with friends to stay in touch.

zh: 我希望你能多给我发信息，这样我能跟上你的生活。
old_en: I hope you can send me more messages so I can keep up with your life.
new_en: I hope you send me more messages so I can keep up with your life.

zh: 我每天练习英语，跟上学习的进度。
old_en: I practice English every day to keep up with my studies.
new_en: I practice English every day to keep up with my studies.
